Title: Where the Devil Can't Go, He Sends a Woman
Actors: Sebastian Stankiewicz, Malgorzata Kozuchowska, Agnieszka Wiedlocha
Plot: Poland in the 80's was a country ruled by crisis and a sense of hopelessness. Only few knew how to turn crisis into a business. It was a golden time for them. How did they operate in a country where almost everything was forbidden?
